-- Integer square root: the largest r with r * r <= n.
isqrt(n: int) -> int =
  pre n >= 0
  post out * out <= n and n - out * out <= 2 * out
  ex isqrt(0) == 0
  ex isqrt(1) == 1
  ex isqrt(10) == 3
  ex isqrt(16) == 4
  var lo = 0
  var hi = 3037000499
  while lo < hi
    let mid = (lo + hi + 1) // 2
    if mid * mid <= n
      lo = mid
    else
      hi = mid - 1
  lo

test_isqrt() =
  assert isqrt(0) == 0
  assert isqrt(1) == 1
  assert isqrt(3) == 1
  assert isqrt(10) == 3
  assert isqrt(16) == 4
  assert isqrt(17) == 4
  assert isqrt(9223372036854775807) == 3037000499
